# Klearo (كليرو)

> Klearo is a bilingual (Arabic & English) Point of Sale (POS), inventory, and business management software built for shops, supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, medical clinics, and dental clinics in Egypt and the MENA region. It works both offline (Desktop) and online (Cloud), supports standard thermal receipt printers and barcode scanners, and includes a 1-month free trial with no credit card required.

## Core Capabilities

- **Fast POS & Cashier Checkout:** Barcode scanning, discounts, cash/card/split payments, returns, and instant 80mm thermal receipt printing.
- **Real-Time Inventory Management:** Automatic stock deduction on every sale, low-stock alerts, expiry-date tracking, supplier management, and barcode stocktaking.
- **Shift Closing & Net Profit Reports:** Instant daily and monthly reports covering sales, expenses, returns, cashier drawer reconciliation, and role-based staff permissions.
- **Offline-First Reliability:** Continues selling, printing receipts, and saving invoices locally even when the internet disconnects, with automatic backups and sync.
- **Deployment Options:** Available as an Online Cloud version or a full Offline Desktop version (Windows & Web).
- **Free Trial & Onboarding:** 1-month free trial with no credit card required, guided setup, data migration assistance, and direct Arabic/English WhatsApp support.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Quick Facts)

- **Does Klearo work without internet?** Yes. The Offline Desktop edition continues selling, printing receipts, and managing inventory even when the internet is disconnected.
- **What hardware does Klearo support?** Standard USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners, 80mm thermal receipt printers, barcode label printers, and supermarket barcode scales.
- **What is included in the free trial?** A full 1-month free trial with no credit card required, tailored setup for your business type, and direct support via WhatsApp.
- **Which regions does Klearo serve?** Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, and the wider MENA region.
- **Can I migrate data from another system?** Yes. Klearo's onboarding team helps import existing products, balances, and customer/patient records.
